about.title: About <1>Me</1>
about.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer with practical experience in freelance projects, working on the complete development of web applications from the database to the user interface.
about.p2: I work mainly with <1>Next.js</1> on the front-end and <1>NestJS</1> on the back-end, applying principles such as <1>Clean Architecture</1>, <1>SOLID</1> and containerization with <1>Docker</1>. I focus on delivering clean, secure, scalable code with a good user experience (UX/UI).
about.p3: Currently, I focus on stacks based on React and Nest.js, always seeking to apply the best development practices, such as TDD, CI/CD and Clean Architecture.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Fullstack blog with authentication, creation and listing of posts between users. The difference is category control: only the administrator defines the available categories, and users choose between them when publishing. Developed with Next.js on the frontend, focusing on SEO and performance, and NestJS on the backend, using its opinionated architecture for a scalable and well-structured API.

wanessa.title: Wanessa Dias
wanessa.description: Landing page for a tattoo studio, focused on attracting new customers and increasing the number of appointments. The page features a gallery of the tattoo artist's work, allowing visitors to evaluate the style, quality and variety of tattoos before getting in touch. alana.description: Responsible for complete back-end development in NestJS, implementing all API endpoints, authentication/authorization with JWT and refresh tokens. Integration with external services like Algolia for advanced search. On the front-end with Next.js, I focused on integration with the back-end and layout adjustments (design based on Lovable). Biggest challenge: implementing support for multiple languages ​​by uploading a Docker container with LibreTranslate for real-time translations.

startup.description: I worked on the maintenance and evolution of a vacancy management system for recruiters. Developed new features, fixes and optimizations in a full-stack application with NestJS (back-end) and Next.js (front-end). The main focus was to calculate and display match probabilities between candidates and vacancies, helping recruiters prioritize profiles with greater compatibility.
